Cybersecurity strategy is documented and approved by senior management
Cybersecurity strategy is aligned to business objectives and regulatory requirements
Cybersecurity strategy is reviewed and updated at least annually
Cybersecurity policies are documented and approved by management
Cybersecurity policies are communicated to all relevant personnel
Cybersecurity policies are reviewed at least annually or upon significant change
A cybersecurity function with defined roles and responsibilities is established
A Chief Information Security Officer or equivalent role is appointed
Cybersecurity responsibilities are documented in job descriptions
A cybersecurity awareness program is established and delivered to all staff
Cybersecurity training is provided to personnel with security responsibilities
Awareness and training effectiveness is measured and documented
A cybersecurity risk assessment methodology is defined and approved
Cybersecurity risk assessments are conducted at least annually
Risk assessment results are documented and reported to senior management
Applicable cybersecurity regulatory requirements are identified and tracked
Compliance status against applicable requirements is assessed and documented
Non-compliance findings are tracked and remediated
Risk treatment options are evaluated and selected for identified risks
Risk treatment plans are documented with owners and timelines
Residual risk is accepted by authorised risk owners
An asset inventory covering information assets is maintained
Assets are classified according to sensitivity and criticality
Asset owners are assigned for all information assets
Access to systems and data is granted based on least privilege
Privileged access is controlled and monitored
User access is reviewed periodically and upon role change or termination
A vulnerability management process is established and documented
Vulnerability scans are conducted at defined intervals
Critical vulnerabilities are remediated within defined timelines
A cybersecurity incident management process is documented and implemented
Cybersecurity incidents are detected logged and escalated
Post-incident reviews are conducted and lessons learned are documented
Business continuity and disaster recovery plans include cybersecurity considerations
Recovery time and recovery point objectives are defined for critical systems
Business continuity and recovery plans are tested at least annually
Network segmentation is implemented to isolate critical systems
Firewalls and network access controls are deployed and configured
Network traffic is monitored for anomalous or malicious activity
Endpoint protection solutions are deployed on all managed devices
Endpoint configurations are hardened and managed
Removable media controls are implemented on endpoints
A change management process is defined and enforced for IT changes
Changes are tested and approved before deployment to production
Emergency changes are documented and reviewed post-implementation
Cybersecurity requirements are included in third-party procurement and contracting
Third-party cybersecurity risks are assessed prior to engagement
Third-party risk assessments are reviewed periodically
Cybersecurity obligations are defined in third-party contracts
Contracts include the right to audit third-party cybersecurity controls
Third-party contracts include incident notification requirements
Third-party compliance with cybersecurity requirements is monitored
Third-party security incidents are tracked and escalated
Third-party relationships are reviewed upon significant changes or incidents
Personal data is identified classified and inventoried
Roles and responsibilities for personal data protection are defined
A personal data retention and disposal policy is established
Technical and organisational controls are implemented to protect personal data
Personal data transfers are controlled and documented
Access to personal data is restricted to authorised personnel
A personal data breach response process is documented and implemented
Personal data breaches are reported to relevant authorities within required timelines
Affected individuals are notified of personal data breaches as required
